public_rationale: Marcus said Tesla FSD 'is getting better' and then asked whether it was getting enough better. Only the first part is a claim. In the weeks before his April 9, 2024 post, Tesla widely released FSD v12.3, which uses end-to-end neural networks. Crowdsourced tracker data reported on April 2, 2024 showed 448 miles between critical disengagements for v12.3. That was more than three times the best v11 result. A March 18, 2024 report described owner feedback on v12.3 as smoother and more capable than earlier versions. Both point to real improvement at the time. The question about whether it was 'enough' better is rhetorical and is not graded.
limitations: The tracker data is crowdsourced, self-reported and based on small samples.
The sources are enthusiast outlets; Tesla released no official metrics.
Only the 'getting better' part is graded, not the 'enough' question.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Tesla FSD is getting better, and he raises the question of whether it is getting enough better.

statement.excerpt: Tesla FSD is getting better. But is getting enough better?

from_speaker: But is getting enough better? (rhetorical question, not an assertion)
our_interpretation: Only the first sentence is a checkable assertion: that Tesla's Full Self-Driving software was improving at the time of the post. The second sentence is a question, so it is not graded.
He named no period. I read 'is getting better' as recent progress in the months before the 2024-04-09 post, which in practice means the FSD v12 rollout from January to early April 2024.
Plain reading: crowdsourced or reported performance data, such as miles between disengagements, or broad reports on driving quality show the newer FSD versions doing better than earlier ones.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence from early 2024 shows newer FSD versions, such as v12.x, performing better than earlier versions, for example more miles between critical disengagements or clearly better reported driving.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence from early 2024 shows FSD performance flat or getting worse compared with earlier versions.
